items.text: At each of the three clinics, for what proportion of patients on warfarin can time in therapeutic range be calculated from the INR and dose records over a four-week profile, and how does completeness differ by testing mode?
items.population: All patients on warfarin managed by the clinic during the profile window
items.concept: Completeness and timeliness of INR and dose records sufficient to calculate time in range
items.context: Main site with paper nomogram and two satellites with the dosing tool

items.text: Among adults on warfarin managed by the clinic, does dosing with the computer-assisted tool, compared with the paper nomogram, increase time in therapeutic range over 26 weeks?
items.population: Adults on warfarin managed by the anticoagulation clinic

finer: q1 is feasible within four hours a week and approval ACM-2026-14 and decides whether q2 can be answered from records; q2 is interesting and relevant to standardisation but its feasibility depends on q1.
summary: A records-profile question first, and the comparison question it gates.
